Hmm, what's the pattern? Maybe the ring is "the position of the clicked blob reflected about the center of the row"? Row 1's center is col 3. Reflection of col 1 about 3 is col 5. No.
Maybe the ring is where the "next green blob" will appear? Or maybe the ring is a "bomb"/"hole" that chases the blobs?
